evidence: decorative_mascot: Data stands on the seesaw pan and points in every hook frame (hook@0.3 to seg0:end), stands on bar tops at seg1:mid/end and seg2:start, and walks along a bar at seg4:mid. He never does a setup, action and payoff tied to the ticks or the undercount.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg3:start/mid the seesaw counts show impossible fractional values like '16.9' and '26.5' counties next to '152 Today'. At seg3:end the scene collapses to an empty frame with two stub bars and a tiny mascot at the left edge, while the narration is still delivering the 9x payoff.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The scene reuses the hook's seesaw machine and tweens integer county counts through decimals, then hands off to a bar scene that starts from zero width. The strongest line in the script ('9 times more places') lands on a nearly blank frame.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make one bespoke depiction of the 29 to 260 counties: a county map or grid where 29 cells are tick-infested and 231 more fill in until 260 read as 9x. Count whole numbers only, keep the frame full through the end of the segment, and give Data a bit, such as swatting ticks as they spread across the cells.
